chapter: Fellow musicians and brass band world
title: Left Hand Buster, trombonist
summary: Remarks on Left Hand Buster's trombone playing and the drinking that killed him.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Well, maybe I didn't know you when I first came around, you know. I didn't know everybody in the bands. I would just follow them. I'd get to know people like Left Hand Buster and so forth. He was one of my favorite trombone players.
Left Hand Buster. Yeah, he was just playing with us.
He was such a ratty trombone player. He could play My Society and it sounded like a blues.
That's right. He could play the trombone and he could play the bottle too. That's what killed him. Is that it? That's what killed him. That liquor.
